name: Nono
source: An innocent girl who likes to play with a flying disc and who's always honest to her friends and herself. She does not know much about the place and circumstances and all Nono remember is that she should search for her lost love. [url=/c35517]Reia's[/url] friend. [spoiler]In the end of Reia route, she disappears[/spoiler].
